still: Close-up of a round hole cut in old wooden floorboards with a shiny brass pole going down through it into darkness, glowing warm light coming up from below, empty space on the left for the host.
video: Slow push-in toward the hole. Warm light flickers up from below. Dust drifts in the light.

still: Cutaway view of a two-storey 1870s brick firehouse at night like a dollhouse: on the ground floor three horses in wooden stalls next to a red horse-drawn fire wagon, on the floor above firefighters asleep in bunk beds under a lantern.
video: Camera tilts slowly up from the horses to the sleeping firefighters. A horse flicks its ears; a lantern sways gently.

still: A straight wooden staircase inside a firehouse; the chunky fire horse is halfway up the stairs, nose in the air sniffing, following a ribbon of steam from a pot of stew at the top of the stairs.
video: The horse lifts one hoof onto the next step and sniffs the steam, ears up. The steam curls toward its nose.

still: A tight cast-iron spiral staircase twisting up through a hole in a firehouse ceiling; the chunky fire horse stands at the bottom looking up at it, head tilted, confused.
video: The horse tilts its head from side to side, then snorts and steps back. Camera drifts slowly around the staircase.

still: Sleepy firefighters in long white nightshirts and boots crammed on a narrow spiral staircase, bumping into each other, one hopping into his trousers, a big brass alarm bell on the wall.
video: The brass bell shakes. The firefighters jostle and bump down the spiral stairs one slow step at a time.

still: A third-floor hay loft in an 1870s firehouse at night lit by a lantern: Captain Kenyon and his buddy stacking hay bales; a long wooden pole runs straight down through a square hatch in the loft floor; a brass alarm bell on the wall.
video: Both men freeze and look up as the bell on the wall starts shaking. Bits of hay float in the lantern light.

still: The buddy wraps his arms and legs around the long wooden hay pole and drops through the square hatch, hay flying up around him, big grin.
video: He slides straight down the pole and out of frame, hay bursting up into the air behind him.

still: Ground floor of the firehouse: the buddy already standing next to the red fire wagon and the horses, dusting off his hands, while behind him other firefighters are still winding slowly down a spiral staircase.
video: He dusts off his hands and grins at camera; in the background the others are still shuffling down the spiral stairs.

still: Captain Kenyon proudly pointing at a freshly sawed round hole in the wooden floor with sawdust around it; the stern fire chief beside him holds up a long paper bill and raises one eyebrow.
video: The chief unrolls the long bill until it hits the floor. Kenyon's smile stays on.

still: Big close-up of the smug rival firefighter laughing with his mouth wide open, pointing at the viewer, other firefighters laughing behind him.
video: He throws his head back laughing and slaps his knee.

still: A red horse-drawn fire wagon racing down a cobblestone street at night toward a glowing burning building, Captain Kenyon standing on the back holding on, sparks in the air.
video: The horses gallop toward the fire; the camera tracks beside the wagon. Sparks drift up into the purple sky.

still: Side-by-side cutaway: on the left a firefighter carefully stepping down a staircase, on the right a firefighter zooming down a pole with motion lines, same height floors.
video: The pole firefighter drops to the bottom while the stair firefighter is still on the first few steps.

still: A grand old firehouse hall with three gleaming brass poles going up through round holes in a high ceiling, warm light reflecting on the brass.
video: Slow crane up along a brass pole toward the ceiling hole. The reflections slide along the metal.

still: A modern fire station at night: the brass pole is closed off behind a small safety fence, and a firefighter in modern yellow gear walks down a normal staircase beside it.
video: The firefighter walks down the stairs; the closed-off pole stays still beside him.

still: Two lit candles on a dark purple stage: the left candle stands in front of a small brass pole, the right candle stands in front of a small spiral staircase, empty space in the middle for the host.
video: Static. Both candle flames flicker gently.
